name: M5 Tough Display
summary: Small touch instrument display for Signal K, on the M5Stack Tough
description: The JSON Layout Player from the P4 Cockpit on a 320x240 M5Stack Tough: values, gauges, bars, anchor watch, a notifications list, an alert overlay with chime and buttons, laid out in the Signal K HMI designer and pushed to the display. Pages switch with a swipe, the status and tab strips can be hidden and shown with a swipe, and number readouts scale up to fill the screen. Brightness is adjustable, and the screen dims when idle at night.

boards.notes: In use on a boat with a Signal K server. The image keeps its own partition table with an extra NVS partition for the layout, so it is laid out for the Tough's 16 MB only.
